## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the concrete problem and what changes for the user.

## Validation

List the focused checks and their results. Identify skipped or unavailable checks
and any platform/version limits. Use synthetic evidence, not private recordings.

## Privacy and observation boundaries

Describe any change to collected fields, scope, redaction, helper processes,
storage, or replay. Explain how observations remain distinguishable from inference
and how attached processes remain unaffected by stopping observation.

## Review notes

Mention material limitations and documentation updates. Before submitting, review
the diff and attachments for credentials, private paths, real sessions, generated
reports, environments, caches and build artifacts. Follow SECURITY.md for sensitive
vulnerability details.
